There is nothing "wrong" with you, and you are definitely not alone in experiencing this. What you are describing sounds incredibly frustrating, and the guilt or regret that follows can be really heavy to carry. Many people struggle with feeling unable to stop eating or eating past the point of fullness. This pattern is often a natural response to stress, emotional challenges, or underlying physical factors, rather than a personal failure.

Because this cycle is causing you distress, it could be very helpful to speak with a healthcare provider or a mental health professional. A doctor or therapist can help you explore what might be triggering these episodes in a safe, non-judgmental space. They can work with you to understand your body's signals and help you build a more comfortable, peaceful relationship with food. Be gentle with yourself right now—acknowledging what you are going through is a brave first step.
